arguments.command: cd /app/work && sed -i 's/        L=C.build(reqs\[i\]); st,val=C.check_response(reqs\[i\],resp,L)/        L=C.build(reqs[i]); st=C.check_response(reqs[i],resp,L)/' vbattery.py && sed -i 's/        nopt+= st=="optimal"; ninf+= st=="infeasible"/        nopt+= st[0]=="optimal"; ninf+= st[0]=="infeasible"/' vbattery.py && grep -n "st\[0\]\|st, val" vbattery.py advrun.py run.py | head && bash all.sh 2>&1 | tail -8
